title: Surface-functionalized walnut-derived hard carbon as a high-rate anode material for sodium-ion batteries
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,6269-6279
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00802F, Paper
Shaowen Huang, Yusong Wang, Bojian Fan, Yingshuai Wang, Kunyu Zhao, Eslam Sheha, Feng Wu, Hongcai Gao
As the foremost candidate anode material for sodium-ion batteries, hard carbon (HC) exhibits exceptional promise, yet its electrochemical performance is constrained by suboptimal initial coulombic efficiency (ICE) and limited rate capability.
